subject: Next steps: lock evaluation kickoff & trial ops
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@vividhealth.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: proposed slots for evaluation kickoff + ask list

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan):

Recap (1-liner): VividHealth wants a 6-week trial focused on EHR parsing and inference latency under 500ms p95 for short clinical notes; key success metric is >92% extraction accuracy on the seed prompt set.

Proposed kickoff format (90 min):
- 30 min technical deep dive (integration points, data access, security)
- 30 min trial plan + success criteria (scoping, sample prompts, evaluation cadence)
- 30 min ops & access checklist (keys, IP allowlist, roles)

Availability — please pick one:
- Tue May 11, 09:30–11:00 PT
- Wed May 12, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu May 13, 16:00–17:30 PT

Prework & attachments: I attached a short trial-charter-template.docx and a sample prompt-set-sample.csv to make the success-criteria conversation concrete. Can you confirm who from your side should attend (technical lead + security + product owner)? Also flag any procurement / PO timelines so Ben can coordinate terms.

If neither slot works, propose two alternatives and we’ll triage on our side.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: trial-charter-template.docx; prompt-set-sample.csv
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@vividhealth.co>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@vividhealth.co>, SaaS Ops <ops@vividhealth.co>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: proposed slots for evaluation kickoff + ask list

Thanks, Kimberly — great summary.

Confirmed attendees from VividHealth: Jordan (engineering manager), myself (product), and Lina from security (copied as ops alias).

We can do Tue May 11, 09:30–11:00 PT — that works best for the team.

A couple of questions / notes ahead of kickoff:
- We have a small redacted dataset we can share for the prompt validation; is a shared S3 bucket + temporary credentials OK?
- Can Redwood pre-suggest quantization/instance types given our latency target? Wanted to know if you need target token lengths or sample traces before the call.
- Procurement: we typically need an SOW + PO within 30 days; I attached a high-level requirements PDF (vivid_health_requirements.pdf) that procurement asked us to pass to vendors.

If you want, Ben and Kimberly can prepare a proposed trial SLA + runbook for the kickoff.

Thanks,
Alex
Product Lead, VividHealth
alex.gomez@vividhealth.co

Attachments: vivid_health_requirements.pdf

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: proposed slots for evaluation kickoff + ask list (slot locked)

Ben / Rachel —

Alex locked Tue May 11, 09:30–11:00 PT for the kickoff. Please see Alex's note and the attached procurement doc from their team. Action items: 

- Ben: please draft a one-page trial SOW and an initial pricing appendix we can share at kickoff. Include optional Dedicated capacity estimate and a note on early-termination credits. (Owner: Ben Carter)
- Rachel: can you prepare a short security pre-check checklist (keys, network allowlist, SOC2 artifact pointer) and be ready to talk about private deployment options if they raise data residency concerns. (Owner: Rachel Kim)
- Kimberly: I'll share the Drive folder with the trial charter and prompt set; I'll also add a short note proposing the evaluation success gate: >92% extraction accuracy on the seed prompt set + p95 latency < 500ms on their redacted traces.

HubSpot / ops: attaching the HubSpot link here so we can update the deal stage: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/23019. Deal id RDW-23019-VIVID — please tag this in the SOW.

Notes for kickoff agenda (I will circulate a calendar invite):
- Intros & roles (5 min)
- Integration constraints & data transfer (20 min)
- Trial scope & success metrics (25 min)
- Prompt set walkthrough (15 min)
- Next steps & procurement timeline (15 min)

Attachments to upload to Drive: trial-charter-template.docx, prompt-set-sample.csv.

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
